description_en: Deletes an ENS security group rule
kebab_example: aliyun ens delete-security-group-permissions --security-group-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --permissions Policy=Accept PortRange=80/80 SourcePortRange=22/22 Priority=1 SourceCidrIp=0.XX.XX.0/0 IpProtocol=TCP DestCidrIp=10.XX.XX.91 Ipv6SourceCidrIp=::/0 Ipv6DestCidrIp=::/0 Direction=ingress --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteSecurityGroupPermissions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group
parameters.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en: The destination IPv4 CIDR block. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported
fields.help_zh: 目的端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: dest_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The direction in which the security group rule is applied.

egress

ingress
fields.help_zh:
授权方向。
egress：出方向。
ingress：入方向
fields.name: direction

fields.help_en:
Protocol type. Valid values:

TCP

UDP

ICMP: the ICMP protocol

ICMPv6: the IPv6 ICMP protocol.

ALL: All protocols are supported
fields.help_zh:
协议类型。取值范围： 
         
TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
ICMP：ICMP协议。
ICMPv6：IPv6 ICMP协议。
ALL：支持所有协议
fields.name: ip_protocol

fields.help_en:
The destination IPv6 CIDR block. IPv6 CIDR blocks and IPv6 addresses are supported.

This parameter and the `DestCidrIp` parameter cannot be set at the same time
fields.help_zh:
目的端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。 

该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置
fields.name: ipv6_dest_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The source IPv6 CIDR block of the security group rule. IPv6 CIDR blocks and IPv6 addresses are supported.

This parameter and the `DestCidrIp` parameter cannot be set at the same time
fields.help_zh:
源端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。
该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置
fields.name: ipv6_source_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The action specified in the security group rule. Valid values:

Accept

Drop
fields.help_zh:
访问权限。取值范围： 
         
Accept：接受访问。
Drop：拒绝访问
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en:
The destination port range of the security group rule. Valid values:

If you set IpProtocol to TCP or UDP, the valid values of this parameter are 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<Start port number>/\<End port number>. Example: 1/200.

If you set IpProtocol to ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

If you set IpProtocol to ALL, the port number range is -1/-1
fields.help_zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的目的端口范围。取值范围：
         
TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1
fields.name: port_range

fields.help_en: The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value specifies a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
fields.help_zh: 安全组规则优先级，数字越小，代表优先级越高。取值范围：1~100
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The source IPv4 CIDR block. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported
fields.help_zh: 源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: source_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The range of source port numbers for the protocols specified in the security group rule. Valid values:

If you set IpProtocol to TCP or UDP, the valid values of this parameter are 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<Start port number>/\<End port number>. Example: 1/200.

If you set IpProtocol to ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

If you set IpProtocol to ALL, the port range is -1/-1
fields.help_zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的源端口范围。取值范围：
         
TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1
fields.name: source_port_range
